answer.rationale: The low-cost vendor is the only stated option that independently meets the mandated 18% spend reduction, and the inherited record indicates prior fast onboarding and accurate invoicing. However, at 94% committed line volume, a full unvalidated cutover creates material delivery-risk exposure. Verify the prior switch record, then constrain the transition to a guarded qualification/initial allocation before committing broader volume, subject to current capacity, quality, lead-time, and continuity confirmation.
